protocol.purpose: Compare compact response predictors; no WeKnora DB access or claim of causal learning gains.

ct.status: exploratory; previous test results already examined

as.status: additional held-out evaluation; schema audit precedes fitting

exclusions: multi-skill event; never broadcast one label to multiple skills
AS non-original or hinted first response when identifiable
protocol.ordering: CT timestamp then numeric row; AS order_id. AS order is an event proxy, not elapsed time.

history_logistic.fit: training; select lambda on validation log loss; no student intercept

protocol.history: Per-student histories reset across splits; predict before observing each current label. Within held-out students, prior observed labels are allowed for online state updates only.
protocol.selection: Lowest validation log loss among all candidates. Test never selects hyperparameters or model.

uncertainty.paired_difference: selected minus skill mean user macro log loss

protocol.transfer: Evaluate source-fitted shared history coefficients, global mean, and BKT on the other corpus with all target skill intercepts unknown; target outcomes only update previous-history features, never parameters. Report as stress test, not enterprise transfer evidence.
protocol.negative_control: Shuffle training labels with seed 20260912, rebuild all label-derived history features, refit history model using selected lambda, evaluate untouched test history. Report even if performance remains strong from skill frequencies.
protocol.deployment_gate: No public-corpus parameters deployed as local component mastery probabilities. Requires local independent outcome validation and content-quality review.
protocol.raw_data: Stored only under .local-data; publish aggregate results and hashes, not learner records.
protocol.schema_amendment: If dataset fields require a change, record it before computing outcome metrics; preserve this protocol and list amendments in results.

limitations: CT test has been examined in earlier work; new analysis is exploratory.
AS label 0 combines first failure and help; not equivalent to independent local checks.
Single-skill, main-problem subset; not all student activity or all component types.
Test measures new users on these corpora; unknown-skill groups may be empty and are reported as such.
Skill intercepts always unknown in transfer stress; no cross-domain parameter refitting.
Matched distribution prediction is not causal policy improvement or enterprise reading validation.
No public parameters are deployed to WeKnora component mastery.
